Subject: Escalation: KIN-4521 — request senior approval for 30% Hosted API rebate (numbers & conditions)

Ben / Mina / Laura —

Kintek Labs (KIN-4521) is asking for a 30% rebate on Hosted API usage pricing to secure a production expansion. Thread below from Sofia. High-level:

Summary:
- Ask: 30% rebate on list usage price for Hosted API (token generation + embeddings).
- Forecast: 3M tokens/month S1 (Q3), scaling to ~10M tokens/month by Q1 next year.
- Proposed commercial trade: 12-month committed spend (pre-discount) of $300k+; case study & reference during onboarding; executive sponsor intro.

Impact & recommendation:
- Economics: at list price $0.0008/token equivalent, 30% off reduces unit revenue materially — projected ARR under this deal is ~$252k (post-discount) over 12 months at our current ramp assumptions.
- Risk: margin compression vs hosted unit cost; operational exposure limited (hosted product).
- Upside: strategic reference in fintech vertical, likely upsell to Dedicated in 6–9 months if latency/cost profile improves.

Conditions I recommend we attach to any >20% concession:
1) Minimum 12-month pre-discount commit of $300k (or prepay for the first 3 months).
2) Standard termination clause with 60-day cure for non-payment; no retroactive rebate beyond committed volume.
3) Customer signs narrow public case study / quote within 90 days of go-live.
4) Security hurdle: SOC 2 type II evidence (they already provided initial SOC doc) and completion of our lightweight security intake before production.
5) CS-led onboarding milestone plan with SLOs and a paid discovery week if we need to build query optimizations.

Attachments: SOW draft and MAP (linked). HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/12345/KIN-4521
DocuSign LOI (placeholder): https://redwood.app/docusign/KIN-4521-loi

Request: Ben / Mina — authorize a one-time 30% Hosted API usage rebate for Kintek under the conditions above. This is time-sensitive (customer asked to close this week).

Thanks,
Aditya
